  Goals: G1 finish started work (Done or explicit blocker) before pulling new 
  work. G2 focus agent context on one epic and one batch. G3 create detailed  
  tasks only for near-term work.                                              
  Non-goals: automatic closure without DoD evidence/authority; automatic      
  session launch, commit or push; replacing Beads as task truth.

  FR-1 Single active epic: only tasks of the epic in delivery are pulled;     
  switching needs an explicit user decision.

  claimed or left half-open.                                                  
  FR-3 Batch selection: batch = all ready, unblocked tasks of the active epic 
  that can run independently, bounded only by the host's subagent concurrency 
  limit (e.g. Goose's configured maximum); Skills never set or override a cap.
  Independent tasks run in parallel subagents with disjoint writable paths.   
  FR-4 Finish before pull: no task outside the batch is pulled until the batch
  closes or a blocker is reported.                                            
  FR-5 DoD-gated closure: close only after Test evidence + Judge accepted +   
  current closure authority; otherwise stay open with named blocker and       
  restart action.                                                             
  FR-6 No speculative tasks: epics not next in line keep goal, outcomes, rough
  scope only, no child tasks.                                                 
  FR-7 Just-in-time refinement: when the active epic has no ready tasks for   
  the next batch, automatically propose Research->Plan refinement for it (or  
  the next epic in order); horizon one batch ahead; tracker writes only with  
  tracker-write authority.

import re
import unittest

    return (ROOT / path).read_text(encoding='utf-8')


def normalize(text):
    return re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', re.sub(r'[`*_]', '', text.lower())).strip()


def action_section(text, heading_pattern):
    starts = list(re.finditer(r'^\d+\.\s+\[.\]\s+(.+)$', text, re.M))
    for index, match in enumerate(starts):
        if re.search(heading_pattern, normalize(match.group(1))):
            end = starts[index + 1].start() if index + 1 < len(starts) else len(text)
            return text[match.start():end]
    raise AssertionError('Missing governed action seam: ' + heading_pattern)


class BatchLoopSourceContracts(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.cycle = read_source('skills/cycle/SKILL.md')
        self.agents = read_source('AGENTS.md')
        self.focus = action_section(self.cycle, r'frame|recover|select.*slice')
        self.dispatch = action_section(self.cycle, r'dispatch|delegat')
        self.join = action_section(self.cycle, r'integrat')

    def assert_policy(self, text, *concepts):
        """Require related concepts within one paragraph or two adjacent ones."""
        blocks = re.split(r'\n\s*\n', text)
        spans = [normalize('\n'.join(blocks[i:i + width]))
                 for i in range(len(blocks)) for width in (1, 2)]
        self.assertTrue(
            any(len(span) <= 2200 and all(re.search(c, span) for c in concepts)
                for span in spans),
            'Missing local policy relationship: ' + ' / '.join(concepts))

    def test_fr1_one_active_epic_across_runs(self):
